description: Capture raw writing material as fragments before any structure exists — the novelist's diary phase. Use when the user has a topic, an idea, notes, a transcript, or a story seed and wants it all down without choosing an order, outline, shape, or structure yet; when they say they want to brainstorm, riff, gather material, or 'get it out of my head'. Structure is writing-outline's job; this skill never organizes.
